text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the day of the Mainichi Okan, all eyes are on the imminent clash between Mejiro Ardan, Oguri Cap, and Inari One.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Amidst the hype, Mejiro Ardan speaks of how Oguri Cap, Super Creek, and Inari One are recently being referred to as the Eternal Top Three.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Considering this a title well worth overturning, Mejiro Ardan makes her desire to win evident and gets ready to race against two of the top three.
